notes.title: The Jackbox Survey Scramble is coming on October 24th!
notes.content:
Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based games, using real one-word answers from real people. The game will be [b]available to play during Steam Next Fest (Oct. 14 - 21)[/b] and will be [b]released at midnight on October 24th[/b].

Enjoy an all-new party experience for the whole family using the family-friendly filter. Play four game modes that constantly change based on answers submitted by real players around the globe, including you! 

Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

[b][h3]Get to know The Jackbox Survey Scramble’s four game modes![/h3]
[/b][list][*] [b]Hilo[/b]: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
[*] [b]Speed[/b]: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
[*] [b]Squares[/b]: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares!
[*] [b]Bounce[/b]: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular to least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer![/list] [b]The Jackbox Survey Scramble will include four game modes at launch, with additional game modes added in a free update before the end of the year![/b]

[h3][b]Wishlist now![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

notes.title: Jackbox Games at C2E2
notes.content:
Are you going to C2E2 this year? We sure are! Join us at McCormick Place from [b]April 26-28th[/b] for some incredible panels with special guests, chat with Jackbox game devs, and play games for a chance to win prizes.

Play games with us! 

Come join Jackbox game devs to play some Jackbox fan-favorites and a few hidden gems. We’ll be in The Yard (Revolution Brewing) handing out prizes to winners. 

[h3]Here’s when you can find us in the Yard:[/h3][list]
[*] Friday 4/26 from 12:30-3:30pm
[*] Saturday 4/27 from 11am-2pm
[*] Sunday 4/28 from 1:30-4:30pm
[/list]
[b][h2]Catch our three incredible panels![/h2][/b]
[h3][b]1. Chicago Comedy Panel:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Friday 4/26 from 7-8pm 
[*] Location: S401-D[/list]
[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/play-games-attend-panels][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2486624840455330680/F85364F76F8263E3CE85DBEEFBD2948B05157593/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url] 

Join some of the funniest writers in the city from Jackbox Games, The Onion, Clickhole, and more as they play through fan-favorite party games with YOU, the audience! Special guests include Hannah Wolansky, Mike Gillis, Nick Mehendale, Steve Etheridge, Chad Nackers, and Liz Anderson.

[h3][b]2. The Jackbox Games Showdown with the Chicago Freelance Wrestling Association:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Saturday 4/27 from 4:45-5:45pm 
[*] Location: S401-ABC[/list]
[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/play-games-attend-panels][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2486624840455374170/45AA6B861D733C3BDAB342671C050F7DA3C365F3/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

Come celebrate Chicago’s illustrious comedy and wrestling scene as members of the Freelance Wrestling roster challenge each other to an epic party game battle. Members of the audience will be able to play along and help decide the outcome of each match! Special guests include "The King of Clubs" Jason Midas, "The Generational Treasure" Shaq Jordan, "The Very Good Boy" Stone Ambrose, "The Big Picture" Nick Kotas, and "The Founder of the Team Alfonso Dojo" Alfonso Gonzalez.

[h3][b]3. Gag! x Jackbox Game Night[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Saturday 4/27 from 6:30-7:30pm
[*] Location: S401-D[/list]
[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/play-games-attend-panels][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2486624840455368109/689199832BE844D94911E350D6E560AABEA75F12/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

Join our “after hours” party game night with some of the most beloved drag artists in Chicago, including members of Gag! Hosted by Jackbox Games and featuring hilarious party games that audience members will be able to join in on. Special guests include Derry Queen, Malheurt, Secret Queen, Rachel Slurrz, Ari Gato, and Chanel Mercedes Benz.

See you there!

Follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/playjackboxgames/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/jackboxgames][b]Twitter[/b][/url] to see pictures from the event, and don’t forget to tag us in yours!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - YOU DON'T KNOW JACK Vol. 1 XL
notes.content:
YOU DON'T KNOW JACK Vol. 1 XL is Now Available on Steam!
The original PC sensation that started it all! We've brought it back in all its virginal glory!

The world was a much simpler place in 1995. The kids were listening to the grunge, the first test-tube gorilla was born at the Cincinnati Zoo, and a little trivia game called YOU DON’T KNOW JACK took the interactive CD-ROM trivia game show world by storm. Play now and relive that crazy, mixed-up time all over again!

Also check out the YOU DON'T KNOW JACK Classic Pack containing additional volumes of the Classic Trivia Game
